function: An element's padding-inline-start is the space from its border to its content, at the start in the inline direction.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Default. The element's default padding-inline-start distance.
Specifies distance in px, pt, cm, etc. Negative values are not allowed. Read about length units
Specifies distance in percent relative to size of parent element in the inline direction.
